fresh_candidate.rule: No disclosed image or unexplained other input and explicit input_images=[] in valid object parameters
fresh_candidate.limit: Candidate fresh generation only; empty exported inputs cannot prove text-only or no external preparation

reference_guided.rule: One distinct image-bound raw asset ID, after higher-priority controls
reference_guided.limit: Binding does not verify properties of the media

multi_input.rule: At least two distinct image-bound raw asset IDs, after higher-priority controls
multi_input.limit: Conditioning, not layers, masks or achieved composition; cross-ID aliases unresolved

local_edit.rule: Literal is_inpaint=true or nonempty mask/layer key
local_edit.limit: Disclosed mechanism candidate only; prompt local_edit_request stored independently; no active records found

reframe.rule: Image input and qwen_camera_control with nonzero angle/move, or flux_2_pro_outpaint with nonzero signed expansion
reframe.limit: Model-scoped control interpretation; prompt framing alone is insufficient
reframe.anchor: controls/framing counts with exact model and raw control values

upscale.rule: Image input with bytedance_image_upscale, or topaz_image/topaz_image_generative with output width or height greater than positive recorded width or height
upscale.limit: Recorded route; topaz nickname alone does not prove size increase or quality improvement

unknown.limit: Includes no recorded image input without explicit empty input_images; not a fresh count

independent_axes.request: Unchanged panel 05.1 and 05.3 assignments; corpus AF3a edit/preservation/reference/lens and short-edit lexical proxies only
independent_axes.construction: At least one resolved image producer input = staged_jobs; at least two distinct image producers = convergent_jobs; neither defines complete build order
independent_axes.mechanism: All mask/layer keys recursively inventoried; is_inpaint raw values and states separate; paint_image is a media input, not automatically a mask
independent_axes.purpose: Unchanged panel 05.5 requests; explicit image output attachment to a video = used_by_video candidate foundation, not final acceptance

input_rule: Typed image roles or generic input_asset at params.input_images[*], input_image, image_reference, custom_reference, paint_image. Generic style/camera/lens/color presets excluded; other inputs kept separately.

dependencies.04: Semantic local-edit/integration/purpose intent and checked model labels
